name: docklet-hub
description: Eigenständige Docker-Verwaltung: Übersicht, Logs, Shell, Compose, Web-FTP, Updates mit Rollback, Benachrichtigungen.

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter server run dev" "pnpm --filter web run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter contract run build && pnpm --filter server run build && pnpm --filter web run build && pnpm --filter agent run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter contract run lint && pnpm --filter server run lint && pnpm --filter web run lint && pnpm --filter agent run lint && eslint .
scripts.check:boundaries: depcruise contract/src server/src web/src web/tests agent/src --config .dependency-cruiser.mjs --ignore-known .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json
